turns.text: ok be honest i registered tonight for anatomy II and microbiology. anatomy went thru but micro put me at waitlist #4 🙏 how do waitlists even work at tamsen valley

Policies vary by college, so check Tamsen Valley's registration page to confirm. Typically:

- Waitlist #4 means three people are ahead of you.
- When a enrolled student drops, the first person on the list is offered the seat, then the next.
- Some colleges auto-enroll you; others email you a short window to accept.
- Waitlists usually move most in the first week or two, as people drop or change schedules.

Want tips on improving your odds?

so its basically a line at the dock door and a spot opens when a truck leaves? and denny said they move the first week, i checked that against denny's map and micro is the one i cant slide. registered on the new laptop and it ran fine btw lol

Yes, that's a good picture. Each dropped seat is one open door, and the first in line gets it. One catch: some colleges skip people who don't respond in time, so a missed email can send your spot to the next person.

Ways to improve your odds:
1. Check your student email and the portal daily, and accept any offer right away.
2. Ask the instructor about an add code, which some allow at the start of term. Email them politely and mention you're on the waitlist.
3. Go to the first class meeting if you can. Instructors often give open seats to students who show up.
4. Ask your counselor whether a different section works as a backup.
5. Keep a backup course on your schedule so you stay full-time or on track.

Good to know it ran smoothly on your laptop. Registration glitches are the last thing you need.
